subject: Azure Marketplace: Publisher account + Offer creation sprint plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, Acme Onboarding <onboarding@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure Marketplace: Publisher account + Offer creation sprint plan

Hi team,

Thanks for the quick connect last week. We're lining up a short sprint to get Acme Analytics into the Azure Marketplace with a SaaS offer and full co-sell registration. Goal is: publisher account activation, manifest + offer draft, technical validation slot, and co-sell enablement within 3 weeks.

Quick asks from our side to help schedule work:
- Confirm any remaining publisher-account activation steps that require your tenant-side action.
- Share the minimal manifest fields that tend to trip customers during validation.
- Let us know available windows for a 60-minute technical validation call (APAC-friendly slots would be helpful).

I've attached the initial offer_manifest.json (draft) and a short sprint plan. Internally we'll own: service principal creation, telemetry endpoint tests, and SSO proof artifacts.

Proposed owners:
- Aditya Rao: service principal + infra smoke tests
- Kimberly Park: manifest and packaging
- Vivek Kulkarni: co-sell intake + GTM metadata

Can you confirm the above and flag any additional pre-validation artifacts we should produce?

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Head of Growth, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: offer_manifest.json (application/json)]

From: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Publisher account + Offer creation sprint plan

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the plan. High level looks good. A few immediate items that commonly cause delays:
1) Publisher account verification: we need the publisher contact verification completed (gov ID / org verification) — if Acme already submitted this, please share the ticket number.
2) Offer manifest: include explicit ARM template references for your SaaS endpoint and an Azure AD app registration section if you plan to support SSO.
3) Service principal: must have Contributor on the subscription used for staging. We can validate with a short test script.
4) Co-sell metadata: Customer-ready use cases and a 1-page solution brief are required for the co-sell intake form.

We can offer a technical validation slot on Thu, 29 Oct 2026 between 09:00–11:00 PST or Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:00–12:00 PST. Please confirm preferred window and list the internal attendees for the call.

Also attached a lightweight checklist we typically send (co-sell-onboarding-checklist.pdf).

Best,
Erin Martinez
Azure Marketplace PM
azure-marketplace@microsoft.com
[Attachment: co-sell-onboarding-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Publisher account + Offer creation sprint plan

Marissa / Kim —

I'll kick off the infra pieces this afternoon. My checklist:
- Create staging subscription and grant service principal Contributor role.
- Run endpoint smoke tests against Acme staging URL (health check + auth flow).
- Generate sample telemetry logs and store retention policy notes.
- Produce a short script for the Marketplace PM to verify SP permissions during the call.

Kimberly, can you finalize the manifest fields for the SaaS plan by EOD Wed so I can wire the infra bits? I'm slating the sample test run for Thu morning so we can capture results before the validation call.

Attachments: svc-principal-steps.docx (draft runbook)

- Aditya

[Attachment: svc-principal-steps.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Publisher account + Offer creation sprint plan

Erin —

Thanks for the checklist. A couple clarifying questions before the technical validation:
- For ARM references, do you require fully parameterized templates or is a high-level template with documented parameters sufficient for the validation step?
- For SSO proof, will a recorded SSO login and the app registration manifest suffice, or do you need a live redirect flow during the call?

Preferred validation slot: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 at 09:30 PST (fits our team's calendar). Attendees from our side: Marissa, Aditya, Kimberly, Vivek.

I've attached a short manifest delta file that shows the SaaS plan and AAD settings — it's not final but should accelerate the review.

Kimberly
Principal Product Manager, Marketplace
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: manifest_delta.json (application/json)]

From: Azure Marketplace PM <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Acme Onboarding <onboarding@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: Publisher account + Offer creation sprint plan

All —

Confirmed: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:30 PST works for the technical validation with our engineering validator (Erin + Sanjay). Pre-call requests:
- Please have the service principal test script available and one person who can run it (Aditya volunteered).
- Share a short link to the staging URL and a test account (read-only) for validation.
- If you plan to demo SSO, please ensure the app registration uses https redirect and that the reply URL is reachable from our validation environment.

Post-validation, we will:
- Provide a validation report with any remediation items (if any).
- Open co-sell intake and advise next steps for GTM alignment.

DocuSign: We'll send the publisher agreement link if Acme's publisher verification is complete. If not, please fast-track the verification ticket and share the ref number.

Looking forward to the call.

Cheers,
Erin Martinez
Azure Marketplace PM
azure-marketplace@microsoft.com
